description: Variation of Condition 17 (Installation of fire surrounds and grates) of listed building consent LB/23/05694 (Modifications to external fa‡ades of built elements, including resolution of level 03 roof terrace above 1950s extension; secondary glazing proposals and associated fabric upgrade; internal alterations to general arrangement layouts; proposed demolition and replacement of the non-original ceilings; changes to third floor lead roof) to alter wording to "Following the commencement of any approved works to remove an existing fire surround, the associated approved replacement surround shall be installed within 22 months from the date of the removal of the existing surround and shall thereafter be maintained' for installation time to be altered from 14 months to 22 months.
